producer_report.summary: Job planning is on in athena.toml. A [job_plan] table at the end of the file sets enabled = true, planner_usd and critic_usd 0.75, both timeouts 600 and max_rounds 3. Tests that need the unplanned path now strip the table wherever it sits (from its header to the next table header). Decision D110 and a CHANGELOG entry record the change, and the 'Built as' note on job 5b in docs/design/job-planning.md lists every test edit. cargo test --locked, clippy and fmt --check all pass.

checks_run.note: Run as `cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast -q`, once before the docs edits and once after. Both runs: every suite ok, 0 failed, including job_plan (22), lifecycle, the athena-data config tests and run_pin_tests.

criteria_check.criterion: athena.toml has a [job_plan] section with enabled = true, planner_usd = 0.75, critic_usd = 0.75, planner_timeout_s = 600, critic_timeout_s = 600, max_rounds = 3, and no unknown fields.
criteria_check.evidence: The section is at the end of athena.toml. The new athena-data test the_repository_config_turns_job_planning_on_with_the_designs_caps parses it and asserts each value. The schema uses deny_unknown_fields, so the parse also shows no unknown fields.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked`: all tests pass, including the repo-config test parsing athena.toml with planning on, crates/athena-cli/tests, run_pin_tests, the athena-data config tests, and xtask's boundary test.
criteria_check.evidence: The full `cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast -q` run shows 0 failed in every suite. That includes athena-data tests/repo_config.rs, the athena-cli integration tests, run_pin_tests, config.rs tests and the xtask policy test, which was re-run after the docs edits.

criteria_check.criterion: Only test code changed under crates/: crates/athena-cli/tests/common/mod.rs, test code in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs, and test code in crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs. No non-test code (planning stage, config schema) changed. The producer's final output lists the changed files and confirms each is allowed.
criteria_check.evidence: Changed files under crates/ are exactly those three. The config.rs edits are all inside `mod tests`. The run_pin_tests.rs edit is in the test helper `config`. The files field lists every changed file. Each one is a listed deliverable or an allowed test file.

criteria_check.criterion: Tests that need the unplanned path strip the [job_plan] section wherever it sits in athena.toml, sharing one stripping helper where crate boundaries allow. Tests appending their own [job_plan] (job_plan.rs, config.rs unknown-key and defaults tests) do not end up with the section twice.
criteria_check.evidence: The three helpers (without_job_plan in common/mod.rs, unplanned in config.rs tests, an inline filter in run_pin_tests.rs) each drop the lines from the [job_plan] header to the next table header. They are three copies because the crates cannot share test code without non-test code; the design note says so. test_config() applies without_job_plan, so job_plan.rs appends to a stripped config. Before the fix the job_plan.rs tests failed with a duplicate key. After it, all 22 pass.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/decisions.md has a new numbered entry turning planning on, citing docs/design/job-planning.md: alternatives from section 7; keep rule from section 9 (landed share of dispatched change jobs, baseline 64%, hold through 30 planned jobs unless it falls, decide at 100 jobs on 72% and a $2.50 cost ceiling per landed job); reversal (set enabled = false).
criteria_check.evidence: D110 at the end of docs/decisions.md lists the section 7 alternatives (a to f), the keep rule (64% baseline from 152 of 237, 30 jobs, 100 jobs at 72% and $2.50), and the reversal (enabled = false).

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry for turning job planning on naming athena.toml; the 'Built as' note in docs/design/job-planning.md mentions every test edit.
criteria_check.evidence: The CHANGELOG [Unreleased] 'Changed' section has the entry naming athena.toml. The 'Built as' note on build item 7 in the design names the three test edits and that no non-test code changed.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`; both pass.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check`. Both exited cleanly.

learnings: Adding [job_plan] to athena.toml breaks every test that appends its own [job_plan]. They hit a duplicate-key parse error, which was the job_plan.rs suite plus config.rs and run_pin_tests.
